title: getrepositorysessionreturnsactivesessiondata
description: Verify that GET /repository/session returns a 200 status with the active UserSessionEntity when a session exists, allowing the app to continue tracking protected app usage.

title: getrepositorysessionreturnsdefaultsessionwhennoexistingstate
description: Verify that GET /repository/session returns a 200 status with a default or empty UserSessionEntity when no existing session state is present, enabling the app to initialize tracking from stored baseline.

title: postrepositoryresetperformssecurecounterreset
description: Verify that POST /repository/reset successfully resets the daily counters and starts a new daily tracking session, returning a 200 success response.

title: postrepositoryresethandlesinvalidrepositorystategracefully
description: Verify that POST /repository/reset returns a non-200 error or failure response when the repository state is unavailable or invalid, ensuring the app keeps the previous state and does not start a new daily cycle.

title: postserviceoverlayshowdisplayslockoverlayondailylimitexceeded
description: Verify that POST /service/overlay/show returns 200 success and displays a full-screen lock overlay on top of protected applications when the daily limit is exceeded.

title: postserviceoverlayshowhandlesmissingpermissionorrenderfailure
description: Verify that POST /service/overlay/show returns an error or failure response when overlay permission is missing or the service cannot render, ensuring the protected app remains visible and the user is not blocked.

title: postserviceoverlayshowreenforcesoverlayafterlimitbreach
description: Verify that POST /service/overlay/show returns 200 success and re-shows or keeps the overlay active if a limit breach has already been detected, enforcing the blocking behavior.

title: postserviceoverlayshowignoresrequestbeforetimelimitreached
description: Verify that POST /service/overlay/show during normal usage before the time limit is reached either returns failure or ignores the request, ensuring no overlay is shown and app usage continues normally.
